description: A small child in a tan raincoat and dark rubber boots walks left through heavy rain, holding a closed-down dark umbrella with a hooked handle in one hand. Under the other arm is a dark cylindrical canister, and a bright stream of white grains or water pours from its open top down past the child's legs and onto a wet, reflective puddle. The background is dark and stormy with diagonal rain streaks, in a painterly, moody style. No visible text, letters, frame or border.
